record: WHAT marketData.transactTime TRACKS -- ESTABLISHED BY MEASUREMENT
why_it_mattered: The entry lane refused any candidate whose `decision_instant - transactTime`
exceeded 30 s. 1,018 valuations have been written by this lane and every one
is NO_TRADE; the candidate ledger's dominant first refusal is VENUE_QUOTE_STALE
with ages of 42 s, 94 s, 287 s and 522 s. If the stamp tracks the RESPONSE those
are stale reads and the gate is right. If it tracks the LAST BOOK CHANGE they are
quiet markets and the gate refuses the entire catalogue while calling it
freshness. The repository recorded the question as open and both readings as

method.how: each contract read TWICE, 20 s apart, against the serving build
method.the_discriminator: a RESPONSE stamp advances by the gap between our two receipts; a LAST-CHANGE stamp does not move at all while the book does not move

the_decisive_detail: Two of the six were inside the 30 s bound on the first read and outside it on
the second -- twenty seconds later, with the stamp unmoved, the book unchanged
and the best ask identical. The prices had not gone stale. Only the clock had

what_changed_in_the_code.admission: the venue arm of `_entry_freshness` and the gate in `venue_quote` now age OUR READ at the decision instant (MAX_OUR_READ_AGE_S = 10 s, both instants ours) and refuse with OUR_OWN_BOOK_READ_IS_STALE_AT_THE_DECISION_INSTANT
what_changed_in_the_code.reported_not_enforced: the last-change age is carried on every quote as `book_last_moved_s` with `book_is_quiet` against the unchanged 30 s threshold. It informs depth and sizing; it refuses nothing
untouched: PINNACLE_MAX_AGE_S = 30 s on the bookmaker's own observation instant
MAX_VENUE_QUOTE_AGE_S = 30 s, now as the quiet-book threshold
the funded lane's own venue_book_age gate, which still refuses on the last-change age and is therefore strictly tighter than the shadow lane

what_this_is_not: NOT a loosening of a freshness bound. No number moved. The 30 s bound was being
applied to a quantity it cannot measure, and it is now applied to the quantity it
can, with a tighter limit (10 s) than the one it replaced.
NOT a claim that a quiet book is a good book. A market that has not moved in nine
minutes may be thin, and that is what the depth and sizing evidence is for.
NOT a claim that any candidate will now qualify. Two of the most recent priced
candidates carried NEGATIVE net edge and one carried a void-rule conflict; those
are economic and payout answers and this changes neither.
the_honest_limit_of_this_determination: One window, six contracts, one sport. 6/6 is unanimous and the mechanism is not
subtle, but a second window on a different sport would strengthen it, and the
probe is a dispatch away. If a later window shows the stamp tracking our request,
this reading is wrong and the code has to go back.
